properties.Mechanism (MOA): Non-selective α antagonist → vasodilation → ↓BP; can cause reflex tachycardia.
properties.Contraindications: Coronary artery disease (relative) due to reflex tachycardia; hypotension.
properties.Indications: Pheochromocytoma (teaching classic); peripheral vasospasm; α-agonist extravasation management (concept).
properties.Adverse effects: Orthostatic hypotension, tachycardia, flushing, nasal congestion.
